scope: M0-G1/G2 facts; not a production robotics connector acceptance

m0_g1.tool_registry: src/llm_loop/tools/registry.py:ToolRegistry.register/get/execute; generic tool registration and execution, not a robot skill safety gate
m0_g1.task_budget: src/llm_loop/resources/task_budget_dispatch.py:TaskBudgetExecution; per-Run provider/tool quotas, transport abort and grant binding; not a robot motion budget
m0_g1.side_effect_registry: src/llm_loop/core/loop/side_effects.py:SideEffectRegistry; persistent effect audit and stop records, not an authoritative physical action ledger
m0_g1.tool_execution_journal: src/llm_loop/core/tool_execution_journal.py:ToolExecutionJournal; tool-side effect journaling, not simulator action_id ownership
m0_g1.goal_store: src/llm_loop/introspection/goal.py:GoalStore.create/checkpoint/update/get; durable Goal and checkpoint, not simulator state
m0_g1.reuse_decision: Reuse ToolRegistry, TaskBudgetExecution and Goal/Checkpoint orchestration; create a small trusted simulator-side persistent action ledger in M1. Never treat generic audit as robot execution truth.

m0_g2.candidate_backend: MuJoCo native physics simulator on macOS arm64; installation and actual simulation capability verification pending M1
m0_g2.decision: Physics engine alone cannot supply persistent action_id or post-crash query; M1 may demonstrate physical pick/place and failure recovery within one process, but MUST NOT claim crash-safe physical replay/reconciliation until independent executor ledger and restart tests pass.
